description: A place's profile on Mappit, for what a place is and who covers it: its written overview (geography, economy, recent history), its five latest stories, the storylines active here in the last 72 hours, the publishers that covered it in the last 30 days, live news radio and TV nearby, S&P 500 companies headquartered there, and current conditions. Use for "tell me about Fort Sumner" or "who covers the news in Boise?". For what's happening there now (the ranked news), use whats_happening.

detail.description: "brief" (default: the overview clipped) or "full" (the whole overview).

include.description: Sections to include, any of: about, stories, threads, sources, radio_tv, stocks, conditions. Default: about, stories, threads, sources.

place.description: The place: a name ("Boise", "Portland, Maine"), a place id, or "lat,lon" (the nearest Mappit place answers).

name: get_location
title: Place profile
